controls.positive: the recursion reproduces Tr L_i^2 from the seeds
controls.negative: n.a. (identities between traces of one algebra)

notes: Traces of products are computed at K+40 and compared to q^K, absorbing the negative q-powers q^{-ab} of the basis normalisation.

checks.name: eq:izero  Tr L_i^a L_{i+1}^b = Tr L_i^{a+1} L_{i+1}^{b-1}, a <= 3, 1 <= b <= 3, all i
Tr L_{i;a,b} = q^{ab} Tr L_i^{a+b}, 1 <= a,b <= 3, all i
eq:pentarec  Tr L_i^n = q^{1-2n} Tr L_i^{n-1} + q^{2-2n} Tr L_i^{n-2}, 2 <= n <= 8, all i
Tr L_i^2 = q^-2 Tr 1 + q^-3 Tr L_i
twisted cyclicity on generators: Tr L_0 L_{i;a,b} = Tr L_{i;a,b} L_1, 80 instances (a,b <= 3, all i)
